notes.note: '8-bit encoding' read as the T.50 character code (0..127); test checks char2int of 'A', 'a', ' ' against their T.50 codes.
'positive' read as non-negative; test checks that a leading 1 bit does not produce a negative (two's complement) value and that '0000'B gives 0.
General error causes (16.1.2 restriction a) tested only via an uninitialized actual parameter (runtime error); C.1.10-004a and C.1.13-008a use the same cause.
General error causes tested only via a wrong number of actual parameters (reject); C.1.12-004a uses the same cause.
General error causes tested only via an actual parameter of the wrong type (reject); C.1.11-004a and C.1.14-011a use the same cause.
